approval.rationale: Conservative raw-grounded mapping: stable identifiers (news_id), title, url, and published date attach to the NewsArticle entity; mutable body text attaches to NewsArticleObservation. Publisher, institution_infos, persons, domains, products, and funding_info are modeled as typed concept relations rather than opaque strings, per the contract. Nested object/array targets use array/* pointer paths with label-bearing target nodes; internal id/label paths are left empty because the source contract does not specify nested structure, preserving unknowns rather than inventing fields.
